title: timeline.move_clip
description: Move a clip to a new start time and/or onto another track of the same type; the clip length is preserved and overlapping targets are rejected. 1:1 mapping to OPP/1 section 8.4 timeline.move_clip (legacy 'new_in'/'to_index' renamed to OPP's 'in'/'track').

in.description: New start time on the sequence timeline (required by OPP/1 section 8.4; re-send the current start for a track-only move).

oneOf.description: Frame index (>= 0). The T1 adapter converts it to Rational using the active sequence/footage frame rate and quantizes to the frame grid.

track.description: Optional destination track id (same track type).
